blocks.content: Learners who spread their reviews out remembered more a month later than learners who crammed, though both groups did about as well the next day. Table 1 lists each group.

blocks.label: figure_title
blocks.content: Table 1: Recall after one day and after thirty days.

blocks.label: text
blocks.content: The chance of recalling an item falls with the time t since it was last seen, at a rate set by its stability S:

blocks.label: text
blocks.content: Each successful review raises S, so the next gap can be longer than the last one.
